hero.lede: Capture, auto-crop, perspective correction, offline OCR and PDF archiving: one complete workflow. No dedicated scanner, and no uploads to the cloud.
hero.alt: UsbScan interface: live preview, document crop frame, page list and scan settings
meta.offline: All processing stays on your device
features.title: A camera workflow built for paper documents
features.lede: From framing to archiving, every step is designed for real document scanning, not just taking photos.
features.cameraDesc: Media Foundation / V4L2 / AVFoundation native hardware capture. Webcams, document cameras, industrial modules and built-in laptop cameras all work.
features.cropDesc: Document corners are drawn live on the preview. On capture, the background is cropped away and perspective distortion corrected; detection safely skips when uncertain.
features.ocrDesc: Uses your local Tesseract 5, with no network and no uploads. Results feed directly into searchable PDFs.
features.pdfDesc: Multi-page PDFs, single-page JPGs or whole-session exports, with file name and subfolder templates configured before capture.
features.uiDesc: A rounded interface drawn with Slint that follows the system light/dark theme; switches, toolbar and cards share one macOS visual language.
features.updateDesc: Choose whether to check for updates in the About window. When enabled, startup checks GitHub Releases and a new version can be downloaded and installed from the bottom-right corner.
workflow.title: Three steps to a finished scan
workflow.lede: No complex image editor to learn; most correction happens automatically when you capture.
workflow.s1Desc: Plug in any USB camera, then pick the device and resolution.
workflow.s2Desc: The preview shows the crop frame live; the shutter auto-crops, deskews and saves.
workflow.s3Desc: Rename, delete, run OCR, then export to PDF or JPG.
download.title: Download UsbScan
download.desc: Automatically detects your operating system and offers the best package. You can also switch platforms below.
download.winCompatDesc: Compatibility: Statically linked runtime — no VC++ redistributable, .NET, or WebView2 needed. Runs on Intel, AMD, and domestic x86 CPUs such as Zhaoxin KaiXian KX-6000/6900.
download.winOcrDesc: Offline OCR plugin: Depends on Tesseract 5. The app has a built-in one-click installer wizard that automatically fetches language packs.
download.winPdfDesc: PDF page import: Built-in Windows.Data.Pdf engine, no extra plugins needed.
download.macPermDesc: Camera Permission: On first launch, grant camera access when prompted, or allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera.
download.macOcrDesc: Offline OCR plugin: Depends on Tesseract. Recommended via Homebrew: brew install tesseract tesseract-lang.
download.macPdfDesc: PDF Import plugin: Multi-page PDF page rendering requires poppler: brew install poppler.
download.linuxPermDesc: Camera Permissions: Add your user to the video group for USB cameras: sudo usermod -aG video $USER, then log out and log back in.
download.linuxOcrDesc: Offline OCR plugin: Install Tesseract and language files via terminal: sudo apt install tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-chi-sim.
download.linuxPdfDesc: PDF Import plugin: Multi-page PDF rendering requires poppler: sudo apt install poppler-utils.
download.recordDesc: Recording: requires system ffmpeg (UOS/Linux: sudo apt install ffmpeg; macOS: brew install ffmpeg).
download.linuxDebDesc: System dependencies: The package declares its required runtime libraries. For offline installation, prepare the matching .deb packages first and check with ldd /usr/bin/usbscan | grep "not found" after installation.
download.uosOfflineInstall: Offline install: run sudo dpkg -i usbscan_*_uos_*.deb. Offline dpkg cannot fetch dependencies; install the runtime-library .deb files downloaded from a matching UOS machine first.
download.uosOfflineDeps: Runtime check: after installation run ldd /usr/bin/usbscan | grep "not found". A standard UOS 20 desktop usually ships the required libraries.
download.uosOfflineOcr: Offline OCR: install tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-chi-sim tesseract-ocr-eng in advance; the app detects language data installed by the system automatically.
download.uosOfflineExtras: Optional components: PDF page import requires poppler-utils; file dialogs require xdg-desktop-portal. Camera access: add your user with sudo usermod -aG video $USER, then log in again.
download.uosOfflineNetwork: Update checks and online language-data downloads fail offline, but capture, crop, deskew, import and export keep working.

page.title: UsbScan — Turn any USB camera into a document scanner
page.description: UsbScan is a cross-platform offline document scanner for Windows, macOS and UOS/Linux: any UVC camera, auto-crop, perspective correction, offline OCR, PDF export and video recording.
download.uosHint: For UOS 20 / Deepin 20 (Debian 10 base). Regular Debian / Ubuntu users should choose Linux.
download.linuxHint: For Debian 12+ / Ubuntu 22.04+. UOS 20 / Deepin 20 users should choose UOS 20.
download.uosArchX86: Hygon, Zhaoxin, Intel / AMD: these use x86_64 (amd64). Choose the “UOS 20 x86_64 Package (.deb)”.
download.uosArchArm: Phytium, Kunpeng: these use aarch64 (arm64). Choose the “UOS 20 ARM64 Package (.deb)”.
download.uosArchUnsupported: Loongson (LoongArch), Sunway (SW64): no official package yet; if the Rust toolchain supports it, build from source on the machine (./build.sh).
download.uosArchCheck: Not sure? Run uname -m: x86_64 means the x86_64 package, aarch64 means the ARM64 package.
